summary: Dyne Therapeutics filed an 8-K furnishing a press release on June 3, 2026, announcing full enrollment (71 participants) of the registrational expansion cohort (REC) for its Phase 1/2 ACHIEVE trial of z-basivarsen (DYNE-101) in myotonic dystrophy type 1. The company plans topline data in Q1 2027, a BLA submission for Accelerated Approval in Q3 2027, and a potential U.S. launch in H1 2028. This is a routine clinical-trial update, not a special situation. No deal terms, price, premium, or board action is involved. Watch for data readouts and regulatory milestones.
